# Toolset `resumes`

Resume viewing and call-tracking phone numbers.

**2 tools.** Mutations require an explicit `confirm=true` argument; `Auth` marks tools that need an hh.ru token.

| Tool | Operation | Auth | Confirm | Description |
| --- | --- | :---: | :---: | --- |
| `get_resume` | `GET /resumes/{resume_id}` | yes | – | Get a resume by id or hash: own resume for an applicant or an accessible resume for an employer. Optional flags add contact credentials, job search status and negotiation history. |
| `get_resume_phone` | `GET /resumes/{resume_id}/phone` | yes | – | Get the phone number of a resume through hh.ru call tracking (employer side; the call is logged by hh.ru). |
